parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Tell me about a family picture that you like the best

If my memories serve me right/ To the best of my recollection, the photo was taken two years ago when my family was on a trip to Phu Quoc island. It reminds me of those good/remarkable memories as smiles are written on their faces.

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
Task 4:
Dear member,
Hello all the members of our club, we are going to organize a competition to pick out the best photograph, since we have many genres of photos, we would like to ask for your opinion that whether we should divide it into different sections and have a section for children under 16 years old. Let us know your opinions and explain why.
Q1: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of the club. Tell your friend what suggestions you will make and why?
Q2: Write an email to the manager. Tell the manager what suggestions you will make and why?
Q1:
Hi Anh,How is it going?I think the idea of separating/dividing the competition into different sections is suitable. We can separate the groups according to the ages and types of photos. What do you think?Love,Amandine
Q2:
Dear Sir/Madam,
My name is Amandine and I have been a member of our club since 2020.
I am writing this email to propose some of my suggestions regarding our club's upcoming competition.
When receiving the announcement, I feel delighted as this is a special occasion for all the members to gather after a long time not seeing each other because of Covid-19 pandemic.
First and foremost, the competition should be separated into diverse age ranges, namely under 18 years old instead of 16 and the counterpart, as middle-age or elderly members have already had enormous experiences in these fields. Therefore, it would be more fair.
Moreover, in order to expand the scale of this event, I suggest that we should open different phases of several genres of photography, for example: portrait photography, landscape photography, architectural photography and so on.
Lastly, we can open a survey to see which type of picture people are interested in.
I am looking forward to receiving your reply.
Yours sincerely,Amandine
